customLabels.label:
How to use the Product Discount Matrix

  • Filter your view by scan status, hierarchy, or any column using the filter icon.
  • Select one or more rows via the checkboxes to perform batch actions.
  • Click Scan to validate selected lines against discount rules.
  • Click Synchronize to push approved discounts to connected systems.
  • Toggle Edit mode to change discount values inline, then click Save.
  • Use the Excel menu to Import new lines or Export the current grid.
  • For individual row options (view details, delete), click the three-dot icon at the end of each row.

Tip: click the lightbulb in the header at any time to hide these instructions.
